#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the release binary ./app from the AArch64 sources in src/.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
mkdir -p build
for src in src/*.s; do
    clang -arch arm64 -c "$src" -o "build/$(basename "${src%.s}").o"
done
clang -arch arm64 -Wl,-dead_strip build/*.o -o app

// eval.s — evaluate one calc expression (see SPEC.md).
//
// Iterative operator-precedence (shunting-yard) evaluator, so arbitrarily
// deep nesting or long unary chains cannot overflow the machine stack.
//
//   int64 eval_expr(const char *cur, const char *end, int64 *vals, uint8 *ops)
//     in:  x0 = first byte of the line, x1 = one past the last byte
//          x2 = value stack, x3 = operator stack; each must hold at least
//               (end - cur + 1) entries
//     out: x0 = value, w1 = 0 on success, 1 on any error
//
// Leaf routine: no stack frame; uses only caller-saved x0-x15.
//
// Operator ids stored on the op stack (precedence in Lprec):
//   0 '('   1 '+'   2 '-'   3 '*'   4 '/'   5 '%'   6 unary '-'

    .set OP_LPAREN, 0
    .set OP_SUB,    2
    .set OP_MUL,    3
    .set OP_DIV,    4
    .set OP_NEG,    6

    .text
    .private_extern _eval_expr
    .globl  _eval_expr
    .p2align 2
_eval_expr:
    .cfi_startproc
    mov     x15, x30                    // return address (Lapply uses bl)
    mov     x4, x2                      // x4 = value stack top (next free)
    mov     x5, x3                      // x5 = op stack top (next free)
    adrp    x12, Lopid@PAGE
    add     x12, x12, Lopid@PAGEOFF
    adrp    x13, Lprec@PAGE
    add     x13, x13, Lprec@PAGEOFF
    mov     x10, #0xcccccccccccccccc
    lsr     x10, x10, #4                // INT64_MAX / 10

// ---- expecting an operand: NUMBER, '(' or unary '-' ----
Loperand:
    cmp     x0, x1
    b.hs    Lerr
    ldrb    w6, [x0], #1
    cmp     w6, #' '
    ccmp    w6, #'\t', #4, ne
    b.eq    Loperand
    cmp     w6, #'-'
    b.eq    Lpush_neg
    cmp     w6, #'('
    b.eq    Lpush_lparen
    sub     w9, w6, #'0'
    cmp     w9, #9
    b.hi    Lerr

Ldigit:                                 // x9 = accumulated literal
    cmp     x0, x1
    b.hs    Lnumber_done
    ldrb    w6, [x0]
    sub     w7, w6, #'0'
    cmp     w7, #9
    b.hi    Lnumber_done
    add     x0, x0, #1
    cmp     x9, x10
    b.hi    Lerr                        // x9 * 10 would exceed INT64_MAX
    add     x9, x9, x9, lsl #2
    add     x9, x7, x9, lsl #1          // x9 = x9 * 10 + digit
    tbnz    x9, #63, Lerr
    b       Ldigit
Lnumber_done:
    str     x9, [x4], #8

// ---- expecting a binary operator, ')' or end of line ----
Loperator:
    cmp     x0, x1
    b.hs    Lfinish
    ldrb    w6, [x0], #1
    cmp     w6, #' '
    ccmp    w6, #'\t', #4, ne
    b.eq    Loperator
    cmp     w6, #')'
    b.eq    Lclose
    sub     w6, w6, #'%'
    cmp     w6, #('/' - '%')
    b.hi    Lerr
    ldrb    w14, [x12, w6, uxtw]        // w14 = operator id
    cbz     w14, Lerr
    ldrb    w8, [x13, x14]              // w8 = its precedence
Lreduce:                                // pop while prec(top) >= prec(new)
    cmp     x5, x3
    b.eq    Lpush_op
    ldrb    w9, [x5, #-1]
    ldrb    w11, [x13, x9]
    cmp     w11, w8
    b.lo    Lpush_op
    sub     x5, x5, #1
    bl      Lapply
    b       Lreduce
Lpush_op:
    strb    w14, [x5], #1
    b       Loperand

Lpush_neg:
    mov     w6, #OP_NEG
    strb    w6, [x5], #1
    b       Loperand
Lpush_lparen:
    strb    wzr, [x5], #1
    b       Loperand

Lclose:                                 // reduce back to the matching '('
    cmp     x5, x3
    b.eq    Lerr
    ldrb    w9, [x5, #-1]!
    cbz     w9, Loperator
    bl      Lapply
    b       Lclose

Lfinish:                                // reduce everything; no '(' may remain
    cmp     x5, x3
    b.eq    Lresult
    ldrb    w9, [x5, #-1]!
    cbz     w9, Lerr
    bl      Lapply
    b       Lfinish
Lresult:
    ldr     x0, [x2]
    mov     w1, #0
    ret     x15

Lerr:
    mov     w1, #1
    ret     x15

// Apply operator w9 (1..6) to the top of the value stack. Branches to Lerr
// on overflow or division by zero (x15 still holds the caller's lr).
// Clobbers only x4, x6, x7, x11 (x8 holds the pending operator's precedence).
Lapply:
    cmp     w9, #OP_NEG
    b.ne    Lbinary
    ldr     x6, [x4, #-8]
    negs    x6, x6
    b.vs    Lerr
    str     x6, [x4, #-8]
    ret
Lbinary:
    ldp     x6, x7, [x4, #-16]!         // x6 = lhs, x7 = rhs
    cmp     w9, #OP_SUB
    b.hi    Lmuldiv
    b.eq    Lsub
    adds    x6, x6, x7
    b.vs    Lerr
    b       Lstore
Lsub:
    subs    x6, x6, x7
    b.vs    Lerr
    b       Lstore
Lmuldiv:
    cmp     w9, #OP_DIV
    b.hi    Lmod
    b.eq    Ldiv
    smulh   x11, x6, x7
    mul     x6, x6, x7
    cmp     x11, x6, asr #63            // high half must be the sign of low
    b.ne    Lerr
    b       Lstore
Ldiv:
    cbz     x7, Lerr
    cmn     x7, #1
    b.ne    1f
    negs    x6, x6                      // x / -1 == -x; overflows for INT64_MIN
    b.vs    Lerr
    b       Lstore
1:  sdiv    x6, x6, x7
    b       Lstore
Lmod:                                   // INT64_MIN % -1: sdiv wraps, msub gives 0
    cbz     x7, Lerr
    sdiv    x11, x6, x7
    msub    x6, x11, x7, x6
Lstore:
    str     x6, [x4], #8
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

    .const
Lopid:                                  // operator id for chars '%' .. '/'
    .byte   5, 0, 0, 0, 0, 3, 1, 0, 2, 0, 4
Lprec:                                  // precedence by operator id
    .byte   0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3

.subsections_via_symbols

// format.s — signed 64-bit integer to decimal text.
//
//   char *fmt_i64(int64 value, char *dst)
//     Writes the decimal form of x0 (no terminator) at x1 and returns the
//     pointer one past the last byte written. At most 20 bytes are written.
//
// Leaf routine: builds the digits in the red zone below sp.

    .text
    .private_extern _fmt_i64
    .globl  _fmt_i64
    .p2align 2
_fmt_i64:
    .cfi_startproc
    tbz     x0, #63, 1f
    mov     w3, #'-'
    strb    w3, [x1], #1
    neg     x0, x0                      // magnitude as unsigned (INT64_MIN ok)
1:  mov     x4, sp                      // digits grow downward from sp
    mov     x8, x4
    mov     x5, #10
2:  udiv    x6, x0, x5
    msub    x7, x6, x5, x0
    add     w7, w7, #'0'
    strb    w7, [x4, #-1]!
    mov     x0, x6
    cbnz    x0, 2b
3:  ldrb    w7, [x4], #1
    strb    w7, [x1], #1
    cmp     x4, x8
    b.ne    3b
    mov     x0, x1
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

.subsections_via_symbols

// main.s — calc driver: read stdin, evaluate each line, write results.
//
// The whole input is read into one growable heap buffer, then split on
// '\n'. Results are collected in a static output buffer that is flushed
// with write(2) whenever it nears capacity and once at exit.

    .set OUTBUF_SIZE, 65536
    .set OUT_RESERVE, 32                // max bytes emitted per line ("-" + 19 digits + "\n")
    .set INBUF_INIT,  65536
    .set SCRATCH_MIN, 256
    .set EINTR,       4

    .text
    .globl  _main
    .p2align 2
_main:
    .cfi_startproc
    sub     sp, sp, #96
    stp     x28, x27, [sp, #0]
    stp     x26, x25, [sp, #16]
    stp     x24, x23, [sp, #32]
    stp     x22, x21, [sp, #48]
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #64]
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #80]
    add     x29, sp, #80
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    .cfi_offset w21, -40
    .cfi_offset w22, -48
    .cfi_offset w23, -56
    .cfi_offset w24, -64
    .cfi_offset w25, -72
    .cfi_offset w26, -80
    .cfi_offset w27, -88
    .cfi_offset w28, -96

    // ---- slurp stdin: x19 = buffer, x21 = length, x22 = capacity ----
    mov     x22, #INBUF_INIT
    mov     x0, x22
    bl      _malloc
    cbz     x0, Lfail
    mov     x19, x0
    mov     x21, #0
Lread:
    subs    x2, x22, x21
    b.ne    1f
    lsl     x22, x22, #1
    mov     x0, x19
    mov     x1, x22
    bl      _realloc
    cbz     x0, Lfail
    mov     x19, x0
    sub     x2, x22, x21
1:  mov     w0, #0                      // STDIN_FILENO
    add     x1, x19, x21
    bl      _read
    cmp     x0, #0
    b.gt    2f
    b.eq    Lread_done
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w0, [x0]
    cmp     w0, #EINTR
    b.eq    Lread
    b       Lread_done                  // treat other read errors as EOF
2:  add     x21, x21, x0
    b       Lread
Lread_done:
    add     x20, x19, x21               // x20 = end of input
    mov     x21, x19                    // x21 = start of current line

    // x23 = evaluator scratch (values, then ops), x25 = entries it holds
    mov     x23, #0
    mov     x25, #0
    adrp    x26, _outbuf@PAGE
    add     x26, x26, _outbuf@PAGEOFF
    mov     x27, #0                     // x27 = bytes pending in _outbuf

Lline:
    cmp     x21, x20
    b.hs    Lexit
    mov     x0, x21
    mov     w1, #'\n'
    sub     x2, x20, x21
    bl      _memchr
    cmp     x0, #0
    csel    x22, x0, x20, ne            // x22 = end of line (exclusive)

    mov     x28, x21                    // skip leading blanks
1:  cmp     x28, x22
    b.hs    Lnext                       // blank line: no output
    ldrb    w1, [x28]
    cmp     w1, #' '
    ccmp    w1, #'\t', #4, ne
    b.ne    2f
    add     x28, x28, #1
    b       1b

2:  sub     x1, x22, x28                // need (len + 1) scratch entries
    add     x24, x1, #1
    cmp     x24, x25
    b.ls    3f
    lsl     x1, x25, #1
    cmp     x24, x1
    csel    x24, x24, x1, hi
    cmp     x24, #SCRATCH_MIN
    mov     x1, #SCRATCH_MIN
    csel    x25, x24, x1, hi            // x25 = max(len + 1, 2 * cap, MIN)
    add     x1, x25, x25, lsl #3        // 8 bytes per value + 1 per op
    mov     x0, x23
    bl      _realloc
    cbz     x0, Lfail
    mov     x23, x0

3:  mov     x1, #(OUTBUF_SIZE - OUT_RESERVE)
    cmp     x27, x1
    b.ls    4f
    mov     x0, x26
    mov     x1, x27
    bl      _write_all
    mov     x27, #0

4:  mov     x0, x28
    mov     x1, x22
    mov     x2, x23
    add     x3, x23, x25, lsl #3
    bl      _eval_expr
    cbnz    w1, Lprint_error
    add     x1, x26, x27
    bl      _fmt_i64
    mov     w1, #'\n'
    strb    w1, [x0], #1
    sub     x27, x0, x26
    b       Lnext
Lprint_error:
    add     x0, x26, x27
    movz    w1, #0x7265                 // "erro"
    movk    w1, #0x6f72, lsl #16
    str     w1, [x0]
    mov     w1, #0x0a72                 // "r\n"
    strh    w1, [x0, #4]
    add     x27, x27, #6

Lnext:
    add     x21, x22, #1
    b       Lline

Lexit:
    mov     x0, x26
    mov     x1, x27
    bl      _write_all
    mov     x0, x23
    bl      _free
    mov     x0, x19
    bl      _free
    mov     w0, #0
Lreturn:
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #80]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp, #64]
    ldp     x22, x21, [sp, #48]
    ldp     x24, x23, [sp, #32]
    ldp     x26, x25, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x28, x27, [sp, #0]
    add     sp, sp, #96
    ret
Lfail:                                  // out of memory
    mov     w0, #1
    b       Lreturn
    .cfi_endproc

// void write_all(const void *buf, size_t len) — write(1, ...) until done,
// retrying on EINTR; gives up silently on any other error.
    .private_extern _write_all
    .globl  _write_all
    .p2align 2
_write_all:
    .cfi_startproc
    stp     x20, x19, [sp, #-32]!
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
    add     x29, sp, #16
    .cfi_def_cfa w29, 16
    .cfi_offset w30, -8
    .cfi_offset w29, -16
    .cfi_offset w19, -24
    .cfi_offset w20, -32
    mov     x19, x0
    mov     x20, x1
1:  cbz     x20, 3f
    mov     w0, #1                      // STDOUT_FILENO
    mov     x1, x19
    mov     x2, x20
    bl      _write
    cmp     x0, #0
    b.le    2f
    add     x19, x19, x0
    sub     x20, x20, x0
    b       1b
2:  b.eq    3f
    bl      ___error
    ldr     w0, [x0]
    cmp     w0, #EINTR
    b.eq    1b
3:  ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
    ldp     x20, x19, [sp], #32
    ret
    .cfi_endproc

    .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_outbuf,OUTBUF_SIZE,4

.subsections_via_symbols
